transpose.js

 
import { constructFrom } from "./constructFrom.js";

The function transposes the date to the given constructor. It helps you to transpose the date in the system time zone to say UTCDate or any other date extension.

Params
date
  • The date to use values from
constructor
  • The date constructor to use
 
export function transpose(date, constructor) {
  const date_ = isConstructor(constructor)
    ? new constructor(0)
    : constructFrom(constructor, 0);
  date_.setFullYear(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate());
  date_.setHours(
    date.getHours(),
    date.getMinutes(),
    date.getSeconds(),
    date.getMilliseconds(),
  );
  return date_;
}

function isConstructor(constructor) {
  return (
    typeof constructor === "function" &&
    constructor.prototype?.constructor === constructor
  );
}

Fallback for modularized imports:

 
export default transpose;
